query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'monetary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as monetary,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'economic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as economic,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'humanitarian' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as humanitarian
FROM indicators;
